headline: Giants To Add QB After Jaxson Dart Injury; OLB Brian Burns To Miss Time
summary: The Giants are moving forward without starting quarterback Jaxson Dart, who is set to undergo knee surgery after tearing his meniscus and MCL in their Week 2 loss to the Rams. headline: 49ers place starting DT C.J. West on IR due to knee injury
summary: 49ers defensive tackle C.J. West, who is going to miss at least a chunk of the season with a bone chip in his knee that will require surgery, was placed on injured reserve Wednesday.

headline: Commanders say clip didn't reflect team response to Daniels injury
summary: After a short video clip showed a number of Commanders walking past Jayden Daniels as he was being helped by medical personnel Sunday, many players fired back at the takes being spouted on social media, emphasizing, "It's bulls--- what people are saying."

headline: The Joey Porter Jr. situation lingers, with no end in sight
summary: With the Steelers facing the Bengals this weekend — and receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins — it would be helpful to have cornerback Joey Porter Jr. on the field.
